notes.title: The Necromancer's Tale: Try the Demo!
notes.notes: [p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1315320/The_Necromancers_Tale/"][/dynamiclink]Our next game, [i]The Necromancer's Tale[/i], is a story-rich RPG in which you experience the origin story of a necromancer, and leverage all of your cunning, underhandedness and sneakiness to advance your black magic ambitions and take revenge on your enemies.[/p][p]The Necromancer's Tale has been in development for over 5 years, and features 400,000 words of narrative from 8 writers, as well as 180+ unique NPC with their own portraits and narrative plots. 25-50 hours for a playthrough.[/p][p]We have just released a [b]new demo which features an in-depth dungeon crawl (with turn-based combat)[/b] in addition to ~3 hours of content from the start of the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7805262/7673de6d17f919bc36e850e70cb09fcfb9671cf3.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1315320/The_Necromancers_Tale/"][/dynamiclink][b]The full game releases in July[/b]. Wishlist it to get notified!  :-)[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Just Released - Goblins & Grottos
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/VFOJQ1T.png?1[/img]

Hey all - I'd like to let you know about our latest game which has just released. Goblins & Grottos reverses the normal roles, and you play as a goblin attacked on all sides by greedy powerleveling adventurers. Also includes a powerful map editor and online sharing system. You can check it out here: [url=store.steampowered.com/app/389190] Goblins & Grottos [/url]

notes.title: Changes in version 1.92
notes.notes:
- improved German translations (thank you to bart jojo!)
- added a volume slider for audio, in the Options dialog
- boosted the coins that Steam users will earn in-game:
- daily 'sponsorship' coins changed from 20 to 40
- all daily laptime prizes doubled, i.e. 2->4, 5->10, 20->40, 60->120
- lap driving ('grinding') bonuses tripled, i.e. 3 coins after 10, 20, 40, 80, 160 laps in a day
- WASD added as a keyboard option, with AZ<> changing to FV<>
